content: That sounds brilliant! Thanks for this gem! I’ll give it a try as soon as I can! :)

I had a closer look (built it, read the referee against the statements, ran a few thousand local races plus some full games with the Boss.java files). 
Really impressive work: the flight model, the expert rules and the FPV split-screen viewer are top quality, and I found no referee bug (invalid outputs, timebank timeouts and random/extreme commands are all handled cleanly)!

One issue: the last bosses (PlannerX, identical in levels 4-6) are much weaker than the Bronze boss (Planner). In their own league, PlannerX beats the Bronze boss only ~13% of the time (300 games each in levels 4 and 6, and 1/16 with the actual Boss files). In mirror games it is destroyed in ~75% of races, almost always on an empty battery, often circling a gate it can't pass within 300. So once Bronze is cleared, the higher leagues are easy. Using at least Planner for Silver and distinct, stronger bosses for last leagues would fix it. (I suppose you’re still busy fine-tuning the bosses :))

Minor suggestions:
- When the only opponent is eliminated (timeout/invalid output), the race keeps running until the survivor finishes or crashes; it could end right away.
- Switching to 2 boosts isn’t a proper mechanic; it’s just a setting. The two boosts can be combined in Gold (3 boosts at once, or 2 boosts plus a faster recharge).And the final league would not introduce any new rules.
- Races are long: 25-45% of boss-vs-boss races from Bronze up reach the 600-turn cap. Stronger bots will be faster, but it may be worth keeping an eye on.
- Small dead code: the "ACRO is not available" branch (ACRO is allowed in every league) and the unused GATE_RIM.

Great game, I'd be glad to see it validated! :)
